hero.title: Web & Print Designer
hero.description: I help small businesses look professional online and on paper — websites, catalogs, menus and brand identities, designed and built end to end.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: Complete solutions for web development and modern design

uiux.title: UI/UX Design
uiux.description: I create intuitive interfaces and websites that look polished and work exactly as expected, designed for people, not just screens.

print.title: Print Design
print.description: I design clear and well-structured print materials, properly prepared for production, with a professional look and clear messaging.

identity.title: Visual Identity
identity.description: I build visual identities that tell your brand story through simple, memorable elements that are easy to recognize.

performance.title: Performance Optimization
performance.description: I make sure your website loads fast and performs reliably across devices and platforms.

about.title: About Me
bio: After 15 years designing for print and web inside a busy company, I now work directly with clients: websites, catalogs, menus and brand identities that look professional and are easy to use.
I combine visual design with frontend development, so the design you approve is the site you get — fast, responsive and built with modern tools like Vue and Nuxt.

process.title: Discover
process.text: We talk about your goals, audience and what success looks like.

process.title: Design
process.text: Wireframes and visual design in Figma, reviewed together before any code.

process.title: Build
process.text: A fast, responsive site in Vue/Nuxt, or print-ready files for print work.

process.title: Launch & support
process.text: Go live, hand over, and stay available for changes.

testimonials.title: Testimonials
testimonials.subtitle: What clients say about working with me

items.name: Bogdan Danaila
items.text: Beyond enthusiasm and a strong focus on quality, he has a client-oriented vision and consistently brings ideas and proposals, offering highly effective and constructive web and graphic design consultancy.

items.name: Michael Dan Popa
items.text: Message strategy, design, implementation, and optimization consultancy are all aimed at retention and visitor loyalty goals, not just at delivering a product as quickly as possible.

items.name: Catalin Bozienita
items.text: We were highly impressed by Bogdan's ability to deliver a corporate identity that perfectly symbolizes our vision and conveys a stylish, elegant, and modern image. We confidently recommend him.

items.name: Iosif Cristian Dietter
items.text: We are very satisfied with our new brand identity and with the way Bogdan approaches his work. It was a great experience and a pleasure to collaborate with him.

items.name: Adrian Stefanescu
items.text: A talented designer with an excellent ability to turn our vision into a fresh, elegant, and well-structured presentation. He quickly understood our needs and delivered creative solutions with great attention to detail. I highly recommend him.

items.name: Laurentiu Bozienita
items.text: Bogdan supported us with both design and website development, and the result came out exactly as we wanted: modern, fast, and easy to use. I recommend him to anyone who wants a well-crafted website, from concept to implementation.
